title: Cross-validation-based optimal feature selection for linear SVM classification
summary: This paper addresses feature subset selection for Support Vector Machines (SVMs) based on the cross-validation criterion. Unlike statistical criteria such as the Akaike information criterion (AIC) and the Bayesian information criterion (BIC), cross-validation requires only the mild assumption that samples are independently and identically distributed (i.i.d.). For this reason, the cross-validation criterion is expected to work well across a wide range of prediction problems, and it has already demonstrated its usefulness as a feature subset selection method for regression.
